G1_G3_k8_reproduces_frozen_artefact.rule: the k = 8 cell of each strand must reproduce its frozen artefact's `throughout` condition exactly: hit-rate residual 0.0 and tokens-per-molecule residual 0.0, aggregate and every seed

G4_cost_identity.rule: the cached backend charges `active` + `active * k` at every guided step, so processed_tokens_actual mod (k + 1) must be 0 for every cell and seed

G5_n1_arms_identical.rule: at N = 1 there is one draft and nothing to rerank; both arms must agree

G6_pool_provenance.rule: the first 512 drafts of each seed must be the published deployed run's 512, compared as SMILES strings

G7_per_draft_token_attribution.rule: sum over drafts of (k+1)*(len(seq)-1) equals the meter's own total

D1_cost_band.rule: C26's 'no compute knob' is REFUTED AS STATED iff max/min tokens per molecule within a single strand exceeds 2.0, every cell being the same method with the same frozen generator, head and lambda

D2_does_the_knob_buy_accuracy.rule: PRODUCTIVE iff hit_rate(k=32) - hit_rate(k=8) > +0.02 with all three seeds sharing the sign; NULL iff |difference| <= 0.02; HARMFUL iff below -0.02 with a consistent sign

D3_frontier_verdict_at_k32.rule: D3a: guidance at k = 32 above/below the oracle-selected curve at its own budget.  D3b: the same against the head-selected curve.  C26's negative result survives in its scoped form iff D3a is 'below' on every strand.

D4_composition.rule: the composition is a usable compute axis for guidance iff at some N it sits above the head-selected curve at its own budget with all three seeds sharing the sign; it dominates iff it also sits above the oracle-selected curve

D5_the_defence.rule: if hit rate is flat in k, the null molecular truncation control is the explanation and must be reported as such -- a statement about a ~2.4k-token SMILES vocabulary, not about FUDGE, which the GPT-2 truncation control (47.5-85.7% of base hit rate destroyed) scopes

P1_cost_is_k_plus_1_times_base.statement: tokens per molecule at k is within +/-10% of 401.619141*(k+1)/9 for every cell of strand A1

P3_knob_is_weak_here.statement: hit_rate(k=32) - hit_rate(k=8) on strand A1 is less than +0.10

P4_below_oracle_curve_at_k32.statement: guidance at k = 32 sits below the oracle-selected curve on every strand

P5_deployed_below_head_curve_at_k32.statement: strand A1 at k = 32 sits below the head-selected curve

P6_strong_arm_above_head_curve_at_k32.statement: strand A3 at k = 32 sits above the head-selected curve

P7_validity_falls_with_k.statement: validity at k = 32 is lower than at k = 2 on every strand

P8_oracle_reranked_above_0p90_but_below_.statement: oracle_reranked at N = 8 exceeds 0.90 hit rate and nevertheless sits below the oracle-selected best-of-N curve at its budget

P9_head_reranked_above_head_curve_termin.statement: head_reranked at N = 8 sits above the head-selected curve's terminal value

P10_cost_band_refuted.statement: the measured max/min token ratio within strand A1 exceeds 3.0, against C26's 1.17
